messages:
Liam (Support): FYI, BrightLeaf says they were billed full usage despite a promotional credit. They pinged support earlier — forwarding convo and invoice link: https://console.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-2026-0045

Liam (Support): Customer claims promo code BRIGHT50 didn’t apply on invoices for Apr. They were expecting ~50% off up to $3k.

Priya (Account Manager): Adding context — BrightLeaf is on a trial promo managed by Sales. Promo meta shows '50pct_max3000' active on signup, but they hit usage spikes mid-Apr and only a partial credit applied.

Ava (Finance): Can you paste the invoice line items + total? I need the contested amount before I approve any goodwill.

BillingBot (system): Usage reconciliation for customer brightleaf (cust_id BF-448):
- Invoice INV-2026-0045 total: $7,850
- Promo credits applied: $450
- Expected promo credit per policy: $3,400
- Discrepancy: $2,950
(Report generated: 1769801800)

Priya (Account Manager): Thanks. Looks like promo was capped incorrectly — should have been $3,400 but system only applied $450. Sales confirms promo terms attached to account.

Raj (Engineering): Quick note from infra: we had a promo-apply race on 2026-04-03 where concurrent provisioning sometimes skipped credit assignment. I can point to the failing job logs.

Ava (Finance): Ok — need one of the following: (A) full manual credit for the missing $2,950, or (B) partial goodwill + ask Sales to invoice-redline. What's recommended?

Priya (Account Manager): Recommend full customer-facing credit to restore trust. We'll follow up with Sales for internal chargebacks if needed.

Ava (Finance): Approved. Credit amount: $2,950 (manual adjustment) + confirm the $450 already applied = $3,400 total promo fulfillment. Please include accounting notes and GL code.

Priya (Account Manager): Copy. GL code to use: "GL-4120" (Customer discounts). Please include note: "Goodwill/promo catch-up — BrightLeaf — Apr 2026. Sales ticket ST-3321."

Ava (Finance): Good. Raj — can you link the incident to the Sales/Support ticket so we have an audit trail?

Raj (Engineering): Yes. I'll attach the job logs and the promo race MR to ST-3321 and tag @Priya.

BillingBot (system): Suggested ledger command (ops use only):
```
redwood-bill adjust --cust BF-448 --invoice INV-2026-0045 --amount -2950 --type credit --gl GL-4120 --note "Goodwill/promo catch-up — BrightLeaf — Apr 2026; sales:ST-3321"
```

Ava (Finance): Finance approves running that adjust. After running, attach the adjustment ID and updated invoice PDF to ST-3321. Also open an accounting ticket ACCT-7860 for month-end reconciliation.

Liam (Support): Noted. Once adjust is applied, I'll update the customer: "We've applied a $2,950 credit to correct the promo; your invoice has been updated to reflect the full promo value of $3,400. Apologies for the inconvenience." :white_check_mark:

Priya (Account Manager): I'll send the customer a short note and a small apology credit coupon for next month.

BillingBot (system): Adjustment queued. Cmd executed by ops_user at 1769804200. Adjustment ID ADJ-22019. New invoice PDF: https://console.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-2026-0045/adjusted/ADJ-22019.pdf

Ava (Finance): Confirming receipt of ADJ-22019 and ACCT ticket created: ACCT-7860. Closing here — please link everything to ST-3321 for Sales review.

Priya (Account Manager): Linked and customer notified. Closing thread. :handshake:
